lead_raw_text:
The structure of Rb4Hg4Br12 (RbHgBr3) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 143), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for Hg, Br, and Rb centers, with Hg–Br distances of 2.65–2.68 Å and Br–Rb distances of 2.90–2.91 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 20 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between Br octahedra and both corner- and edge-sharing between Rb octahedra.
